title: MP716 upgrade manifest
description: Canonical UTF-8 JSON object stored between the fixed header and the vendor-compatible payload. The byte string is covered by the Ed25519 signature together with the header and the payload SHA-256. Placeholder hardware revisions and empty hashes are not valid release values.

allow_downgrade.description: Even when true, the device still refuses a downgrade unless the operator flag is set for that invocation.

base_firmware.description: Vendor firmware generation this image is built on. Current devices report 014. This field must not be replaced with the custom version.

custom_firmware.description: Self-developed firmware version. Must equal firmware_version. It is not the vendor software version.

hardware_revision.description: Must match the device profile. The schema example value validated-revision is rejected by the packer.

signing_key_id.description: First 8 bytes of SHA-256(raw Ed25519 public key), lowercase hex.
